keyFindings.description: The round-2 supersede note re-certifies, as current on 2026-10-23, a claim this same branch makes false. The learning's live bullet still reads 'a red job never sends the issue back, and READY is accepted with a note that the base requires no check'. This change deletes that note: readyChecks no longer reads rules/branches at all, the len(required)==0 arm that produced 'no check is required on <base> of <repo>, so READY was published without reading the head's checks' is gone, the published fixture now carries the already-merged sentence (packages/contracts/fixtures/daemon-api/handoff-complete.json), packages/contracts/CHANGELOG.md says a base requiring none produces no note at all, and prompts_test.go's TestNoComposedPromptSaysLegionRefusesAMergeOverACheck fails any prompt saying 'no check is required on'. The note added by commit 4e229996 does not retire that clause - it preserves it by name: 'The rest of the finding stands: the empty rules/branches/<base> read and what it means for the daemon's verdict and for READY'. The only READY content in the finding is the false clause. This is the learning an agent reading about this exposure opens first (skills/legion-oracle/SKILL.md:47-56), and the implement handoff itself calls it 'the one an agent is likeliest to read tomorrow'. One clause: extend the note to cover the bullet (READY reads no check and answers no note) and drop 'and for READY' from the rest-stands list.

Entry 19 of the daemon API contract log is the historical record of what contract 19 shipped - its own paragraph ends 'A plugin or image built before 19 would ...' - and this branch rewrote its HandoffCompleteResponse parenthetical to today's refusal list ('a head that is not the approved one plus retro's commits, a head GitHub no longer shows'), which is not what 19 shipped, dropping the base-requires-none case that was. The forward-looking statement already lives in packages/contracts/CHANGELOG.md and packages/pi-legion/CHANGELOG.md, so the history needs no update; restore it. The rewrap also leaves the orphan line '// base); the'.

TestAREADYMergeGitHubLeavesWaitingTellsTheArchitectOnce, the branch's primary acceptance test for 'tells the architect once', still enqueues record.ReadyMerge{Number, Head} with no Queued, so after round 2 it reaches mergeWaitWarn only through the queued.IsZero() fallback at auto_merge.go:159-162 - a payload shape workflow.queueReadyMerge can no longer produce, since ready.go:43 always stamps Queued. The two new tests set it; this one was not updated with them, so the headline test now pins the compatibility branch rather than the production path. One field. Its inline next_at/last_error/warned query at :471-479 also duplicates the readyMergeState helper the same commit added at :1566.

roundOneFindingsVerified: Finding 1 (the no-CI clause) fixed in c5cf5ed4f0d6: all three copies now read 'a head with no CI is one a base that requires a check will not merge' - packages/daemon/internal/prompts/go/worker-common.md:19, skills/legion-worker/SKILL.md:404 and the regenerated packages/claude-envoy/legion/skills/legion-worker/SKILL.md:404, which I read rather than taking check-dist's word.

Finding 2 (the warn gate) fixed in 113214e789ee: the gate is now !payload.Warned && errors.Is(cause, wait.ErrWaiting) && waited > mergeWaitWarn && !permanentRefusal(row, cause, now), and TestAREADYMergeFailureThatIsNoWaitSpendsNoWaitingNotice holds the row on a GitHub 500 past the hour, asserts no notice and warned false, then lets GitHub answer BLOCKED and asserts one notice naming BLOCKED and not 500. permanentRefusal is rightly kept beside the wait test: a stalled ghautomerge.Lagging is both a wait and a cause finishRefused tells the architect of.

Finding 3 (the reopen clock) fixed in 113214e789ee: record.ReadyMerge gains Queued, stamped by workflow/ready.go:43 on both the acceptance path (ready.go:30) and the reopen path (ready.go:221), so readyMergeConflict's payload upsert resets the clock and Warned together. TestAReopenedREADYMergeWaitsItsOwnHourBeforeWarningAgain asserts the reopened submission is silent minutes after its queue and names '1h2m0s ago' an hour on, with created_at unchanged throughout. json:"queued,omitzero" is sound at go 1.27.1 (packages/daemon/go.mod:3).

Finding 4 (the rollback note) fixed in d57679e9c340: the entry now carries the paragraph in the shape of the one at CHANGELOG.md:184-190, naming warned, queued and the merge-waiting kind with their two statements, and says why the notice is deleted rather than rewritten to merge-refused.

Finding 5 (docs/solutions) fixed across d57679e9c340 and 4e229996a895, and wider than I named: seven live imperatives carry a supersede note, each retiring only the clause that names the deleted line and saying what still stands. I re-read every remaining 'CI:' hit under docs/solutions; all are either inside a superseded clause or historical narration - except the INFRA-117 bullet above, which is a different defect.
fastFollowJudgement: The architect asked whether either fast-follow is a correctness risk. Neither is. The rememberWait fold is duplication: I confirmed with the code-quality pass that ghautomerge.Submit constructs every error standalone and wraps none of these types in another (ghautomerge.go:185-219, removal.go:113-147), so *Armed and *MergeFailed are mutually exclusive and the reorder is unobservable - which makes the fold safe, not required. The readyChecks rename is naming. Both stay on the Fast-follow line.
